Belomorkanal is a Belgian instrumental four-piece consisting of Sebastiaan (Guitars), Benji Jacobs (Bass), Giel Bervoets (Guitars & Synths) & Simon Bormans (Drums) based in Leuven/Brussels. They fuse post- to more proggy rock sounds with walls of noise, melancholic interludes, pounding riffs and gentle blankets of sounds that make you feel the distant warmth of better times.
